notes.title: BLOODY NEWS, HORROR FANS --- "OXIDE room 208" IS OUT NOW!!!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/89d390f61a68a6e93cd64c142140537654ad0105.png"][/img][/p][h2][b][i]"You wake up naked and wounded in a rusty fridge..." welcome to OXIDE room 208[/i][/b][/h2][p][/p][p]To our press friends, fellow streamers, dear players and horror fans, WELCOME HOME!!! <3[/p][p][/p][p]After much effort and dedication, we finally have something RAW and BLOODY to share with you. Today we write to you with all our enthusiasm to invite you to enter into a terrifying experience with our thrilling action and body horror game [b]OXIDE Room 208[/b]. Would you dare to try a little piece of it?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/a903e87f2d94e2c372389f4aa2a37b7a01665dce.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Don’t miss out on this gripping body-horror packed with tons of action, blood, and heart-racing surprises for those of us who live for the thrill of gaming. OXIDE Room 208 — NOW AVAILABLE on Steam and consoles![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2217720"][/dynamiclink][i]"...Eight people trapped in an old laboratory find themselves caught up in sinister circumstances as they try to survive their final moments in this action-packed, terrifying body horror game full of gore and madness. Immerse yourself in a nightmare where the boundary between flesh and insanity blurs. Oxide Room 208 challenges you to face your fears in a dark and twisted environment."[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b][i]A physical edition that will make your hair stand on end...[/i][/b][/h2][p]Since we’re in celebration mode, we’re also thrilled to reveal the physical console edition, arriving this Halloween thanks to our collaboration with Tesura. If you’re a horror fan, this is a must-have for your trophy collection![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/cdefcb291751360fedcb99163233dfb848bdbbe6.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h2][b][i]Do you need us to tempt you a little more or are you already determined to walk through this door?[/i][/b][/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",344"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/d0828d96cc34bbaad6e8c0bb9842ede7d695caa2.jpg"][/img]Eight characters will try to escape from this nightmare. How many do you think will survive?.[/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/eea2448dcdc94867ffbd5e2833a20c7526b224cb.gif"][/img]Grotesque flesh-and-bone abominations will hunt you down, and remember — those who’ve fallen in OXIDE Room 208 don’t come back the same. If you spot a returned one… run!.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/cb78e24142173d3145b1ba23dee0ddef4470f636.jpg"][/img]Doc will relentlessly pursue you to hunt you down. Feel constantly watched without knowing from where he might attack again.[/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/beba2393f11373db43f66b0be2c214536ea50163.jpg"][/img]Watch your step! As if the creatures and Doc weren't enough, the cells, the old mine, the laboratory and the rest of the areas are full of traps and cut paths. You should better watch your steps.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/4ca14a6d64834a3f8d9802ed0bb1d1a06d38bf36.jpg"][/img]We don't recommend you to be nice to the creatures, but not all of them will behave the same. Each character has its own interactions and storyline, so enjoy the experience!.[/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/83a390ec36052b26d56797d4c797f8b30e15c138.jpg"][/img]Remember to turn on "Stream-safe" mode if you're live. The visceral terror of OXIDE ROOM 208 may not be for everyone, but if you're into this kind of bloody mess, you will feel at home.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/6ed0334f06ffc49fb0176353ffbcc46905232382.jpg"][/img]When you choose a character, you will have to finish their story unless you prefer to be stuck in 208's limbo forever... in that case, choose another character and enjoy the surprise.[/p][/td][td colwidth="344"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/15396ab2d594f1eb577517e8541ea8f095507858.jpg"][/img]Raytracing, Nanite tech, motion capture, and real actors scanned in 3D — all designed to deliver an immersive, visceral experience. Fully voiced in English and Spanish, and backed by a killer soundtrack. Like what’s under the hood?[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3][b][i]Warning: OXIDE Room 208 is a demented, intense, visceral, and unforgiving experience.[/i][/b][i] If you are a sensitive person, play in public spaces, or plan to stream your game live, be sure to activate "Safe Mode for Streaming" before you start playing. Dare to cross Door 208... Stay in touch, horror fans! ----- [b]The OXIDE room 208 Team[/b][/i][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/55e27ecff2059ff9c59e5ac4dc2fb4624ac672b9.gif"][/img][/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: OXIDE ROOM 208 HITS STEAM ON JULY 25TH! --- welcome home, horror fans 😈
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/2a45a5de0c2ddde77b903228218d4aea6f045312.gif"][/img][/p][h3][i][b]Warning: OXIDE Room 208 is a demented, intense, visceral, and unforgiving experience.[/b] If you are a sensitive person, play in public spaces, or plan to stream your game live, be sure to activate "Safe Mode for Streaming" before you start playing. Dare to cross Door 208... if you dare. Stay in touch, horror fans! ----- [b]The OXIDE room 208 Team[/b][/i][/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="5uWZVH9ET60;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]"...Eight people trapped in an old laboratory find themselves caught up in sinister circumstances as they try to survive their final moments in this action-packed, terrifying body horror game full of gore and madness. Immerse yourself in a nightmare where the boundary between flesh and insanity blurs. Oxide Room 208 challenges you to face your fears in a dark and twisted environment."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]1. Chronology of a massacre. THE STORY[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/79ef0f83f65a1b690befb4d7ec8e4d6d378a5c0a.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p][b]Oxide Room 208 [/b]tells the story of eight people who are trapped by the ruthless Doc and forced to be connected to his experiment, Oxide. This dark and twisted place is controlled by Eva, an innocent victim used by Doc in his cruel research to turn her into the host of the experiment. However, Eva's sanity has reached its limit, causing the experiment to spiral out of control and create an organic, hellish environment that transcends reality. Now everyone is trapped in this nightmare filled with grotesque creatures and dangers, inspired by an old motel and the underground laboratory facilities where many atrocities were committed in the name of science. If you want to survive the night, find door 208 and go through it at all costs.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]2. Dissecting the victims (the usual suspects)[/b][/h2][p]Two shady characters trying to shoot a dirty movie with an undercover cop, a cannibal hiker and his fiancée, a rock legend searching for answers, a half-naked madman who seems to feel right at home down there, and two famous streamers from a well-known horror channel will be the perfect victims for the twisted creatures that roam the corridors of Doc's facility, and he has no qualms with mutilate their flesh and twist their memories until they are consumed and nothing remains, keeping hidden his terrible secret and his questionable and unethical experiment.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/2ab9fdccc8ac20690774c1b39892a3963fa17fa5.png"][/img]  [/p][list][*][p]We all have some secret we can't tell anyone. So don't trust anyone! Some of those present have a much more sinister motive than just escaping from there alive.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]When a character dies, there’s a good chance you will see them again, but they will have changed for the worse. Avoid the revenants at all costs[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/b2e8971e9456a63da92ab8f7d751e42f73331a01.jpg"][/img][b][i]** All characters in Oxide Room 208 are real actors and actresses digitized using motion capture techniques.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]3. Pure body horror. Welcome to Doc’s lair[/b][/h2][p]Explore different, eerie environments: Survive your journey through the forest, avoid the creatures lurking in the old mine, enter the underground laboratory where the experiment went haywire, or try to escape with your life through the greenhouse or the old motel while the rest of the survivors rot in the containment cells. Try different paths to avoid deadly encounters or find the armory and let the massacre begin. Visit seven different horror-filled locations that will make your hair stand on end.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/836ffdd19d50cfc205566cc64d4fecc05c828c7e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]4. Creatures Born of Nightmares[/b][/h2][p]You are not the only one living in hell. The facilities are teeming with grotesque abominations, creatures born of chaos that defy reason. Their murderous intelligence and stealthy movements will relentlessly pursue you. Every encounter with these beings is a blow to the senses, a reminder that terror lurks around every corner, waiting to devour your last glimmer of hope.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/4e5702facaf99fd717a0d5f68bb21ff25190c731.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]When certain creatures see you, they will relentlessly pursue you throughout the facility. But don't just run blindly, because you might end up running into something even worse.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]With art focused on the #bodyhorror genre and over a dozen different types of foes, Oxide Room 208 will test your sanity.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]5. The Fight for Survival[/b][/h2][p]More than just a game, Oxide Room 208 is an immersive survival experience. Interaction with the environment is visceral: you manage your weapons and resources realistically, feeling every shudder in your hands as you take hold of your destiny. The camera, constantly shifting between the up-close first-person view and the expansiveness of third-person view, gives you a brutally intense experience of every moment.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/bc5ab71f103696ed254618b39951e2c65b31f5cc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]6. KEY FEATURES:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Nine Real Characters: [/b]Each character is based on actors who were digitally captured using motion capture and facial scanning. Forget simple skins; their stories, scars, and secrets blaze the trail into the unknown.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Organic and chilling environments: [/b]From the grim motel hallways to sinister experimental facilities, every location is filled with details that will immerse you in horror.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Immersive dual perspective: [/b]Switch between first and third person to experience the horror from every angle and get the most out of your adventures in Oxide Room 208 with photo mode.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Cutting-edge technology: [/b]Unreal Engine 5 revolutionizes every scene with ray tracing, stunning dynamic lighting, and realism that will blur the line between fiction and reality.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Top-notch soundtrack and effects:[/b] With an exclusive vocal track by legendary rock band Sôber and a playlist curated by the talented ANBR music, we'll prove that rock and horror go hand in hand. Plus, both will be playable characters (ANBR music as Samael Tselios and Carlos Escobedo as Carlos Miller). You’ll experience all this in a terrifying atmosphere filled with sounds and effects that will remind you that you're not alone down there and that something could always jump out of the shadows.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880672/05aaa1df20f6088b39885f7b3d582b9a19c19044.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Any last words before entering?...[/b][/h1][p]If you think you have what it takes to face humanity's worst, stare into the abyss and not blink, and dig into a brutally honest storyline, you've come to the right place. Oxide Room 208 is a meat grinder, a space for anyone without fear of being consumed by darkness. The experience is intense, visceral, and unforgiving. Step through Door 208... if you dare to cross over.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2217720"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
